observations: No new photos were provided after the seller reply.
The original photos still show wooden pallets (at least one clearly in photos 0–1, and multiple stacked pallets in photo 2) on a concrete floor/yard setting.

claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing, while...
claims.evidence: Seller text is generic and not testable from photos.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photos cannot confirm dryness, whether any water was added, or how they are sorted by grade.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No scale ticket/receipt or weighing photo is shown; seller’s statement alone is not proof.

claims.claim: No o, I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true. Please check again.
claims.evidence: This is a text-only assertion; no new evidence or photos were provided.

risks.risk: Total quantity/weight may not be 500 kg (photos show pallets but cannot verify the full lot weight).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the certified scale reading with the entire pallet lot on it, or a scale ticket/receipt showing date/time and weight.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller, worst-case lot (not guaranteed 500 kg).

risks.risk: Pallet condition/grade may vary (photo 2 shows some boards that look worn/darker; could be mixed).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of multiple pallets showing cracks, broken boards, missing nails, and underside condition (at least 3 pallets).
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed/used pallets with possible wear.

risks.risk: Moisture/odor/infestation risk (seller claims clean/dry; photos cannot confirm moisture content or pest treatment).
risks.proof: Moisture meter reading (if available) and/or photos of pallet ends/underside plus a short video showing no wetness; ask for HT/MB stamp if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed dry/treated (assume standard used pallets).

risks.risk: Non-standard pallet size or incomplete deck (affects resale/use).
risks.proof: Measure and photograph one pallet with tape (L x W x H) and show underside stringers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic pallets with unknown dimensions.

proof_requests: Scale proof: photo/video of the certified scale reading with the full lot OR a scale ticket/receipt.
Condition proof: close-ups (top deck, underside, end grain) of at least 3 pallets from the stack.
Treatment proof: any HT/MB/IPPC stamp—clear close-up if present.
Dimension proof: one pallet measured with tape (L x W x H) plus underside view.
response.reason: The seller’s text-only insistence does not replace missing evidence. Without scale proof and clearer condition/grade photos, the worst-case pricing assumptions must stand.
